propositions: Environment variable REBAR_DETECTED_BY or --detected-by flag must stamp a detected_by field onto ticket CREATE events at the creation seam (composer.create_core), with the flag taking precedence over the env var.

Normalization must strip whitespace and lowercase the value; empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset (field absent); unknown tokens are stamped verbatim without enum enforcement or creation failure.
The detected_by field must be projected additively into compiled state by process_create (mirroring source_* blocks), and events lacking the field must reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior.
The optional detected_by field must be declared in ticket_state.schema.json and registered in the env-var/docs registry.

All local ticket creation paths (CLI, library create_ticket, MCP) must converge on and respect the environment variable or explicit flag; Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) intentionally bypasses composer.create_core and does not stamp detected_by.
